lines.l: Say what you have to say now
Don't keep me on the line with my heart on the plate
So could you do me a favor?
Forget to call me when you're in pain
If you can't love me better
Because for you I know I'd fall again
Pretend you didn't know we would come to an end
Now, I'm flattered by your voice
So could you do me a favor
Forget to call my name when you're in pain
If you can tell me better
Because for you I know I'd fall again
